target_devices.windows: native Windows 2025 CI; user PC installs prebuilt package only

cases.symptom: Windows PowerShell 5.1 on a Chinese locale failed to parse UTF-8 without BOM release-manifest.json.
cases.root_cause: Get-Content used the host default text encoding before ConvertFrom-Json.
required_controls: All release JSON is read with ReadAllText and strict UTF8Encoding(false, true).
The exact generated package runs Install-Phase2Prebuilt.ps1 -PreflightOnly under Windows PowerShell 5.1.
The preflight report must be pass before an artifact is published.

cases.symptom: The Slice B installer failed while reading the existing Python version from ~/Library/Application Support/PicotooPetV2.
cases.root_cause: The executable path variable was invoked without quotes, so the shell split Application Support into separate arguments.
required_controls: Every executable path variable is invoked as a quoted command argument.
The native install fixture uses a runtime path containing Application Support.
The full offline install, authenticated API verification, queued-task preservation and rollback fixture must pass on native arm64 macOS.

cases.symptom: User machines must never be used as build or repair environments.
cases.root_cause: Release confidence must come from native CI and package-level verification, not user-machine compilation.
required_controls: Packages include all runtime payloads and dependencies required for offline installation.
Failed release jobs upload clearly labeled diagnostic evidence; only passing jobs publish install candidates.
